clips.title: The story
paras: Around Mirkfallon Lake, Pridewing Venom Sacs are sought by the night elves of Astranaar. Reports suggest Horde agents harvest the poison for covert attacks, and the Sentinels mean to deny them that supply.

Pridewings hunt from the crags south of Ashenvale, especially around Mirkfallon Lake. These airborne predators are native to the Stonetalon Mountains, and their venom can be gathered from the glands in their bodies. Reports from Theramore suggest Horde assassins are taking that poison to coat blades for covert attacks on night elf settlements. In Astranaar, Sentinels send scouts to hunt the wyverns and collect their venom glands before Horde agents can claim them.
